title: Memorizing Long-tail Data Can Help Generalization Through Composition
abstract: arXiv:2510.16322v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep learning has led researchers to rethink the relationship between memorization and generalization. In many settings, memorization does not hurt generalization due to implicit regularization and may help by memorizing long-tailed examples. In this paper, we consider the synergy between memorization and simple composition -- the ability to make correct prediction on a combination of long-tailed features. Theoretically, we show that for a linear setting, memorization together with composition can help the model make correct predictions on rare test examples that require a combination of long-tailed features, even if such combinations were never observed in the training data. Experiments on neural network architecture on simple data show that the theoretical insight extends beyond the linear setting, and we further observe that the composition capability of the model depends on its architecture.

translated_title: 记忆长尾数据可以通过组合帮助泛化
translated_abstract: 深度学习促使研究人员重新思考记忆与泛化之间的关系。在许多情况下，由于隐式正则化的存在，记忆并不会损害泛化能力，并且通过记忆长尾样本还可能有所助益。在本文中，我们考虑了记忆与简单组合之间的协同作用——即在长尾特征的组合上做出正确预测的能力。从理论上讲，我们证明了在线性设置中，记忆与组合相结合可以帮助模型在需要长尾特征组合的稀有测试样本上做出正确预测，即使这些组合在训练数据中从未出现过。在简单数据上针对神经网络架构的实验表明，这一理论见解可以推广到线性设置之外，我们还进一步观察到，模型的组合能力取决于其架构。
tldr: 记忆长尾样本与特征组合能力相结合，可以使模型对训练中从未出现过的长尾特征组合的稀有测试样本做出正确预测，且这种组合能力依赖于模型架构。
en_tdlr: Memorization of long-tailed examples, combined with composition capability, enables models to correctly predict rare test examples requiring combinations of long-tailed features never seen in training, and this composition capability depends on the model's architecture.
